title: __NAME__
description: A list of items with every item up to the current stage marked. Replace this description with what your component shows: its first sentence is the catalog summary.

items.description: The items, in order, one line each.

stage.description: Index of the current item: items up to it are marked and it is shown in bold; -1 marks none. Drive it from the slide with `advance` or set it in steps. Newly reached items fade in when the step animates.
